# MadeVisa

> MadeVisa (madevisa.com) is a free job search site for people who want to work in another country. Every day it collects jobs posted in the last 14 days from companies' own career pages and open job boards, marks the jobs whose ads state visa sponsorship, and publishes work-visa guides for 21 countries. It does not issue visas, act as an immigration adviser or guarantee a job or a visa.

## Main pages
- [Jobs abroad](https://madevisa.com/jobs): all live jobs, filter by country, visa sponsorship, remote, salary
- [Jobs that state visa sponsorship](https://madevisa.com/jobs/visa-sponsorship)
- [Work visas by country](https://madevisa.com/destinations): routes, requirements, time to permanent residence, official links
- [Job market, live](https://madevisa.com/job-market): jobs by country and company, visa sponsorship share
- [CV match](https://madevisa.com/cv-match): compares a CV with each job, in the browser only
- [How MadeVisa works](https://madevisa.com/how-it-works)
